title: Adjust auth probe to simulate semantic-release fast-forward push

comments.author: derek
comments.text: Updating release workflow auth-probe job to checkout origin/main, create empty commit, and run git push --dry-run origin HEAD:main for release-like validation semantics.

comments.author: derek
comments.text: Updated auth probe in release.yml to mirror semantic-release push conditions: fetch origin/main, checkout local main from origin/main, create empty probe commit, and run git push --dry-run origin HEAD:main. This removes expected non-fast-forward noise from feature-branch HEAD probes.
